title: Beware
body: This junk app might work great, it might be the best AI note taker in existence. I will never know because I will never use it again after the first attempt. I understand in-app purchases. I get the work that goes into developing an app like this. I would charge for it as well. But someone made the moronic decision to wait until you record your first meeting, then lock your meeting summary behind a paywall. Not a one-time trial use, THEN make you pay. No, record your meeting, then lock your summary. Here is why that is a monumentally stupid decision, and whoever made it should be fired: 1. I don’t get to actually trial your app. I don’t get to see how accurate it is, how efficiently the summary is designed, or any features beyond recording. Any dumb app can record. That’s been a basic phone function for 20 years. The only reason I can fathom for locking the very first use summary away, IS IF YOUR AI SUMMARY ABILITY SUCKS AND YOU WANT TO MAKE A CASH GRAB BEFORE PEOPLE FIND OUT. 2. It infuriates your potential customer BEFORE THEY EVEN USE YOUR APP. The app absolutely does not make it clear that you do not get even one single full use without paying. So I had a 40 minute meeting, go to enter my notes, and PAYWALL. This makes me feel like my notes, my job, my livelihood, are being held hostage. It’s like a person selling their home allowing someone to find financing to buy, but not letting them see the inside of the house until they sign a contract. Ok, no problem, I’ll go use FIREFLIES some other competitor.
